text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6f6a78

g.text: * Shaded selected row. Ranking: highest equally weighted mean; then highest final-quarter mean; then smallest candidate ID.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6f6a78

g.text: Each candidate: nine rate/need cells × two tuning seeds = 18 environments. Entire sweep: 324 episodes; no adaptive proposals.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6f6a78

g.text: Worst-environment and worst-cell values are diagnostics, not selection criteria. All candidates and adverse outcomes are retained.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6f6a78

g.text: A supplied-family population baseline; no private optimum, equilibrium, global optimum or independent evolutionary replication is implied.
